{{Quote|We lost Sten, Deadeye, Blunt, and Jark.|Captain Sharp, after the battle against Ventress|<ref name="ISotR 2" />}}
'''Deadeye''' was the name of a [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|clone cold assault trooper]] who served in the [[Devil Dogs]] unit of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[44th Special Operations Division]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Deadeye fought in the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]], in which they were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during an engagement with the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and several [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] while on a mission to destroy a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[weather-control station]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Very good, sir. I will prepare a detachment of my best commando units to accompany you.|Major Kendal Ozzel, dispatching Deadeye and the Devil Dogs with Plo Koon|<ref name="ISotR 1" />}}
Deadeye was the name<ref name="ISotR 2" /> of one of the numerous [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to fight in the ranks of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="databank" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Deadeye served as a [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|cold assault trooper]]<ref name="ISotR 2" /> in the [[44th Special Operations Division]]'s [[Devil Dogs]] unit under the command of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]].<ref name="ISotR 1" /> Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Battle of Khorm date" /> Deadeye participated in the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]], in which the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] battled the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] for control of the valuable [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] on the frozen planet [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]]. As part of a Republic advance force led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], and [[Tauht]], Deadeye and the Devil Dogs were able to land on the surface of Khorm before a storm in the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] blocked the way for reinforcements.<ref name="ISotR 1" />

[[File:BX_ambush.jpg|thumb|left|260px|BX-series droid commandos ambush the clone troopers.]]
The Republic ground forces soon captured an [[agrocite processing facility]] and received intelligence from Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wieler]] about a [[Trident (starship)/Legends|Confederate starship]] effortlessly passing through an opening in the storm. Realizing that the storm had been manifested by a local [[weather-control station]] constructed by the Confederacy, Koon and Fisto took the Devil Dogs, including Deadeye, and set off on [[CK-6 swoop bike/Legends|CK-6 swoops]] to destroy the station and make way for the Republic reinforcements. After making a brief stop to bury the [[Death/Legends|dead]] bodies of several native [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] in a village devastated by the storm,<ref name="ISotR 1" /> the Republic strike team proceeded to scale the nearby [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] on foot. There, they were ambushed by the Confederate [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].<ref name="ISotR 2" />

Ventress [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|engaged]] the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|battle]], while her [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] emerged from the [[Water/Legends|snow]] and attacked the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. After a brief duel with the Jedi, Ventress used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|bring an avalanche down]] upon the Republic forces. She then searched for any survivors and personally slew those she found before leaving the scene. Deadeye was among the casualties sustained in the encounter with Ventress and the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. However, the Jedi had managed to create a [[Protection bubble|Force bubble]] that protected them and several clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], including Devil Dogs [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sharp]], from the avalanche. After Ventress left, the remaining members of the Republic strike team continued on their mission, destroying the weather-control facility<ref name="ISotR 2" /> and allowing the Republic to win the battle.<ref name="ISotR 3">[[The Clone Wars 9|''The Clone Wars'' 9]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Like all clone troopers, Deadeye stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="databank" />

==Equipment==
Deadeye wore clone cold assault trooper [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="ISotR 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Deadeye first appeared in [[The Clone Wars 8|''The Clone Wars'' 8]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]], and illustrated by [[Scott Hepburn]],<ref name="ISotR 2" /> and released on [[August 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="ReleaseDate">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-239/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-8|text=STAR WARS: THE CLONE WARS #8}}</ref>
